action_args.justification: The series is trend-dominated with unstable model ranking (Kendall tau -0.084) and high error correlation (mean 0.762, 8 groups). The plain mean of the full 19-model pool is the most robust combination: it benefits from the diversity of the pool without chasing window-specific rankings that do not hold. Every sub-pool variant scored worse, the weighted meta-model was indistinguishable, and the median was worse on RMSE. With only 3 validation windows, any further weight estimation adds variance without a reliable signal. The full-pool mean is the simplest strategy that matches the series' characteristics: strong trend, no seasonality, and a need for robustness over selectivity.
